title: [0.1] Establish release truth baseline
description: Establish the real current state of the repo (dependency resolution, compile errors, test failures, runtime failures, environment-only failures, stale docs/spec references) before implementation resumes. Create docs/RELEASE-0.1-STATUS.md.
acceptance_criteria: The repo has a checked-in release status document. Build/test/runtime status is known. No product behavior changed. Stale OpenSpec/docs references are identified.

title: [0.1] Package signed OSS release
description: Prepare a signed and notarized GitHub release-quality app distribution. Confirm product identities, entitlements, installer DMG/ZIP, install/uninstall docs, and Sparkle update path.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh install works. App opens without Gatekeeper warnings. CLI helper locates and links. Uninstall removes app state cleanly.

title: [0.1] Validate persistence and crash recovery
description: Verify and harden the persistence layer to handle database/engine restarts and aborted operations (engine/app killed mid-run, stale VM state, port forward cleanup).
acceptance_criteria: Restarting app/engine does not corrupt state. Transient states recover. No zombie port mappings or selected resources remain.

title: [0.1] Complete CLI doctor and core command parity
description: Make the CLI a reliable support and diagnostics tool. Complete core container lifecycle commands, normalize output format, add --json support, and label experimental commands.
acceptance_criteria: CLI can diagnose issues. CLI and app agree on runtime state. CLI core commands work. Shell command is stable. Experimental commands are labeled.

title: [0.1] Stabilize app UX for release
description: Harden the SwiftUI application shell to handle loading, error, empty, mutation, and disabled states across containers, images, volumes, networks, machines, and clusters.
acceptance_criteria: User is never shown a dead action without explanation. Empty sections look intentional. Deletions confirm before executing. Sidebar navigation is stable.

title: [0.1] Integrate GhosttyKit terminal backend
description: Replace the process+pipes terminal placeholder with a real terminal emulator backed by GhosttyKit. Target local shell, containers, and machines SSH. Ensure proper resizing and focus.
acceptance_criteria: Local shell, container shell, and VM SSH terminal connections work. Terminal closes cleanly. Focus and resize are robust.

title: [0.1] Validate and fix native container lifecycle
description: Validate and fix the native container lifecycle (pull, create, start, stop, restart, remove, mounts, ports, logs, cleanup) against hello-world, alpine, and nginx.
acceptance_criteria: Core container lifecycle works from app and CLI. Engine restart does not corrupt state. Remove cleans DB and files. Logs accessible after exit.

title: [0.1] Harden runtime diagnostics and first-run setup
description: Make Flying Dutchman clear about which runtime mode (native, cli, or stub) is active. Expose runtime mode, framework availability, kernel availability, initfs, engine, XPC, HTTP, database, and system status.
acceptance_criteria: User knows exactly why containers can/cannot run. fd doctor gives actionable output. Stub mode is visibly marked. Diagnostics survive restart.

title: [0.1] Harden Kubernetes enough for experimental release
description: Harden VM-backed K3s cluster creation, listing, kubeconfig generation, and deletion enough to showcase as an explicitly badged experimental feature.
acceptance_criteria: Kubernetes remains hidden/experimental or passes basic single-node validation. Failed clusters clean up fully.

title: [0.1] Harden Machines enough for experimental release
description: Harden virtualization Linux Machines lifecycle (create, boot, stop, restart, delete, SSH, IP detection) enough to ship as an explicitly badged experimental feature.
acceptance_criteria: Machines pass validation or are clearly marked Experimental and do not block container workflows. Deleting a machine cleans up guest disk images.
